text: Nde Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen immini halkugol yimɓe Luutu ɓen hewtunoo ka Luutu, o saɗtiraa fii maɓɓe, arugol maɓɓe ngol sunini mo, sabu ko jiiɓodu ndu o anndiri yimɓe makko ɓen. Tawde Malaa'ikaaɓe ɓen ardirii mbaadi worɓe, yimɓe makko ɓen non, ko ittirayɓe tuuyu mun e worɓe tun. Kono Malaa'ika'en jaabii mo: wata a hulu, ɓe hewtirtaa ma bone, wata a suno kadi e ko men humpitirmaa halkugol ɓe ngol; men daɗndete an e ɓeynguure maa nden, si wanaa debbo maa on, o jeyaama e heddotooɓe e halkaare nden, men waɗtiday mo e maɓɓe.
